exact_claim: For n vertices and n-1 arc-disjoint spanning out-arborescences of arbitrary roots, with parallel arcs retained as distinct colored elements, there is a spanning out-arborescence choosing one arc of every color.
success_test: An all-n proof or valid counterexample satisfying all original hypotheses. Fixed-root failure and finite enumeration alone do not resolve this target.
budget: Five substantive author turns unless a complete candidate occurs earlier; independent review required.
duplicate_check: Prior gate clear in checked repository history, all-ref paths, branch names, PR searches and recovery records.
prior_attempt_gap: No substantive or invalidated attempt found in checked records; inaccessible vanished work cannot be excluded.
